matched_queries: Employer responsibilities and worker rights: Applying union ballot thresholds, industrial-action mandates, picketing requirements or statutory union reporting rules.
Discover UK employment guidance for Trade Union Act 2016: repeal provisions. Task relevance is separate from current law, commencement and a need to edit.

passages.quote:
This code of practice provides practical guidance on picketing in trade disputes for those contemplating, organising or taking part in a picket or activities associated with picketing.

The code has been updated to reflect the legal provisions made by the Employment Rights Act 2025. It supersedes the code of practice on picketing issued in 2024.
